findings.text: Requirement #3 ("measure the header height at 400 px before and after — shots at 400 and 1200 of /framework/ux/Dictate/ and one other module page") was never done: there is no screenshot, no measurement, and no mention of either anywhere in task.jsonl, files.jsonl, or the single commit (9f963c99). The CSS change itself is plausible but unproven — nobody has confirmed the header actually shrinks on a real render.

Requirement #2's fallback ("if time runs short, ship step 1 only and leave step 2 as a To-do line in ext/Doc's readme") wasn't followed either: public/framework/ext/Doc/readme.md has no line about the title-as-switcher idea. A reader of the readme has no trace that step 2 was ever asked for or deferred.

Doc.css:50-62 carries an explicit 2026-09-29 design note arguing the tab bar should WRAP rather than scroll, citing "persistent navigation never moves or hides" as the reason it deliberately overrides ext/tabs' own nowrap+scroll default. The new mobile rule (Doc.css:20-32) reinstates exactly that nowrap+scroll behavior below 600px, which the owner's own requirements.md explicitly asks for — so it's the right call, but the old comment block now reads as contradicted and should probably get a line pointing at the new one so the next reader doesn't think the mobile fix is an oversight.

No check_page (or any other render check) run shows in this task's files — only the diff and a brief skill-loading log. Worth confirming the page still boots and the header doesn't visually break before this merges.

experiment.try: force the mobile tab row to one scrolling line instead of letting it wrap to a 2nd/3rd row below 600px
